method: async authenticate(req:Request,guest=false){const bearer=req.get('authorization');if(bearer){assert(/^Bearer [A-Za-z0-9_-]{30,100}$/.test(bearer),'NEEDS_REAUTH');const token=bearer.slice(7);const devices=await this.db.transaction(this.options.companyId,'AUTH_DEVICE',tx=>tx.list('device'));const now=Date.now();const device=devices.find(d=>d.companyId===this.options.companyId&&d.data.tokenHash===hashToken(token)&&d.data.active===true&&(d.data.revokedAt===undefined||d.data.revokedAt===null)&&(d.data.revoked_at===undefined||d.data.revoked_at===null)&&typeof d.data.tokenExpiresAt==='string'&&Number.isFinite(Date.parse(d.data.tokenExpiresAt))&&Date.parse(d.data.tokenExpiresAt)>now);assert(device,'NEEDS_REAUTH');const actor=await this.engine.getActor(device.data.employeeId,this.options.companyId);assert(actor.companyId===this.options.companyId&&actor.userId===device.data.employeeId,'NEEDS_REAUTH');const bound=bindRequestAuthority({...actor,mfaVerified:false},{kind:'device',companyId:actor.companyId,userId:actor.userId,deviceId:device.id,tokenHash:hashToken(token)});return {actor:rememberRequestAuthority(req,this.db,bound),token,device,csrfToken:null,guest:false};}const cookies=parseCookies(req.get('cookie'));const token=cookies[guest?GUEST_COOKIE:SESSION_COOKIE];assert(token&&/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{30,100}$/.test(token),'NEEDS_REAUTH');const result=await this.db.query('SELECT user_id,company_id,mfa_verified,created_at FROM auth_sessions WHERE token_hash=$1 AND company_id=$2 AND revoked_at IS NULL AND expires_at>now()',[hashToken(token),this.options.companyId]);const session=result.rows[0];assert(session,'NEEDS_REAUTH');const actor=await this.engine.getActor(session.user_id,session.company_id);return {actor:this.bindSession(req,{...actor,mfaVerified:freshMfa(session.mfa_verified,session.created_at),mfaVerifiedAt:new Date(session.created_at).toISOString()},token),token,csrfToken:csrfFor(token),guest,device:undefined};}
